_about: Limits for the print style, for tools/look.mjs --check: node tools/look.mjs --shots hills,wood,coast,alpine,valley,river,desert,city,space --styles print --check tools/look/print.json (npm run check:print runs it after tools/print_check.mjs). The same kind of rule as in targets.json. A frame of the print style is cut into six inks and the paper, so what is held is what such a frame is: few hues and few colours, flat blocks of them, a sky that is lighter at the horizon, paper left bare, and a far land that is clean.

rules.why: a frame is in few hues: the cells of 30 degrees of hue that hold a twentyfifth of the pixels with any colour in them (blue, green and ochre: 3 measured in a day, 2 and 3 in the space and the city)

flat blocks of ink: more than four in five pixels are within 0.008 of L of each of their four neighbours (0.869 measured; the lines and the edges between inks are what is not)

the sky is indigo at the top of the frame and paper at the horizon: the lowest sixth of its rows is lighter than the highest sixth by L 0.42
